answer: A rising tide of new wallets cannot amplify itself, since fresh accounts start at zero tenure and must lock real collateral before their signal counts. Each agent must stake a bond on a public terrace of reputation, and every vote emits a signal weighted by stake times tenure. To flood the vote, an attacker must fund hundreds of bonded identities and hold them across many epochs, making each fake voice expensive and slow to build. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
